title: Changepoint localization via nested exchangeability tests: from point estimates to confidence intervals
abstract: arXiv:2611.07399v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study distribution-free uncertainty quantification for a changepoint estimate in an offline setting. We observe a sequence with a single changepoint and are given an estimate of its location. The pre- and post-change segments are independent and each consists of i.i.d. (or, more generally, exchangeable) observations from arbitrary and unknown distributions. We introduce Changepoint LOcalization via Nested Exchangeability testing (CLONE), a novel method for constructing distribution-free confidence intervals around that estimate by testing exchangeability in nested windows centered at the reference estimate. Under these assumptions, CLONE provides finite-sample coverage for any black-box reference estimator. Using a geometrically shrinking radius grid, CLONE requires only $O(log n)$ permutation tests. We characterize optimal scores for the framework and provide practical recommendations that result in sharp confidence intervals. Unde

translated_title: 基于嵌套可交换性检验的变点定位：从点估计到置信区间
translated_abstract: 我们研究了离线环境下变点估计的无分布不确定性量化问题。我们观察到一个具有单一变点的序列，并已获得其位置的估计值。变化前后的数据段相互独立，且各自由来自任意未知分布的独立同分布（或更一般地，可交换）观测值组成。我们提出了CLONE（Changepoint LOcalization via Nested Exchangeability testing，基于嵌套可交换性检验的变点定位），这是一种新颖的方法，通过在以参考估计值为中心的嵌套窗口中进行可交换性检验，围绕该估计值构建无分布置信区间。在这些假设下，CLONE能够为任何黑盒参考估计器提供有限样本覆盖保证。借助几何递减的半径网格，CLONE仅需O(log n)次置换检验。我们刻画了该框架下的最优得分，并给出了实用建议，从而获得紧凑的置信区间。
tldr: 该论文提出CLONE方法，通过在以变点估计值为中心的嵌套窗口中进行可交换性检验，为任意黑盒变点估计器构建具有有限样本覆盖保证的无分布置信区间，且仅需O(log n)次置换检验。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes CLONE, a method that constructs distribution-free confidence intervals with finite-sample coverage for any black-box changepoint estimator by testing exchangeability in nested windows centered at the estimate, requiring only O(log n) permutation tests.
